source: DSTU 7624:2014 (draft, docs/papers/), annex В.11.1.3 (encryption with padding), programmatically extracted from the PDF text layer and cross-checked against В.11.1.4 (decryption: same key, ciphertext and plaintext). kw_input_hex is the annex's own `padded` line: M || mu_{l/2}(N) LE || the B.2 padding, followed by the all-zero block KW itself appends (§15.2). Single lineage: UAPKI/cryptonite share these annex examples (T-234), and Bouncy Castle's DSTU7624WrapEngine has no padded mode, so there is no independent second implementation (docs/DECISIONS.md D-241).
